opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowship Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current members of the Royal Historical Society who are within five years of submitting their corrected doctoral thesis in a historical subject; normally resident in the UK; not in permanent full-time academic employment; current doctoral students not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Supports career-building research or professional activities in the post-PhD period, enabling researchers to produce a clearly defined scholarly outcome (e.g. article or book proposal).

opportunities.title: Martin Lynn Scholarship in African History
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current Postgraduate Members of the Royal Historical Society studying for a PhD in African history.
opportunities.summary: Annual award to assist a postgraduate researcher of African history with their doctoral research.

opportunities.title: Open Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current members of the Royal Historical Society who are not postgraduate students or early career researchers (more than 5 years from completing their PhD).
opportunities.summary: Supports historians without access to research funding to visit archives, historical sites, conduct interviews, and attend conferences.

opportunities.title: Postgraduate Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current Postgraduate Members of the Royal Historical Society studying for a Master's degree or PhD in History (not open to those who have completed their doctorate).
opportunities.summary: Provides funds to postgraduate historians to undertake historical research, such as visiting archives or historic sites and conducting interviews.

opportunities.title: Early Career Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current members of the Royal Historical Society who are within five years of submitting their corrected doctoral thesis in a historical subject (excluding parental leave, illness or caring responsibilities); not open to postgraduate research students or those more than five years beyond PhD submission.
opportunities.summary: Provides funds to early career historians to undertake research activities essential to developing their projects, such as visiting archives, historic sites and conducting interviews.

opportunities.title: David Berry Fellowship in the History of Scotland and the Scottish People
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current members of the Royal Historical Society at all career stages, from PhD research and beyond, in any of the Society's four membership categories.
opportunities.summary: Annual award to undertake research on the history of Scotland and the Scottish people worldwide, including travel, accommodation and research material costs.

opportunities.title: RHS Workshop Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current Fellows or members of the Royal Historical Society (lead organisers).
opportunities.summary: Enables historians to come together to pursue projects of shared interest, including discussion of research topics, testing research ideas, developing teaching practices and networking.
